## Derived item verdicts

11 pass · 5 partial · 4 not-run. Partials: `datasource-admin-lifecycle`, `external-schema-introspection`, `external-schema-drift-gate`, `connector-auth-kind-application` — each ref states that its LIVE half is not pinned, and those halves were not hand-driven in this Tier 1 pass — plus `notify-inbox-delivery` (A3's 501 half blocked by fixture). Not-run: `external-schema-browser-ui` (its only pin covers half of acceptance[6]: the API-layer 503 mapping at objectui 4016370a, 16/16 green) and three Tier 3 items.

## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps (for the wave anchor card)

- `datasource-credential-refusal-matrix`: the knownGap "no Postgres recipe is proven / the QA container has none" is stale — Postgres 16 is installed at `/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin`; working recipe: `initdb -A scram-sha-256` as `postgres`, `pg_ctl … -o '-p PORT -k DIR -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1' start`, create a login role with a password and its database, bind through `POST /api/v1/datasources` with `secret` (parent dirs must be traversable by `postgres`). Hardening observation (latent, not a fail under the declared verify — the mask is never served by a read door): `PATCH /api/v1/datasources/NAME` with `secret` set to the literal mask string is accepted 200 and rewraps the stored secret to the mask (the reconnect then fails), and `PATCH` with `config.encryptionKey` set to the mask overwrites the stored key — no echoed-mask guard in service-datasource's update path; acceptance[6]'s "writing the mask value back verbatim" presumes a served mask. The metadata door serves the opaque `external.credentialsRef` handle while the admin door serves only `hasSecret` — say whether intended. A third read door, `GET /api/v1/data/sys_metadata` (admin only), also redacts — name it. `turso` is absent from `GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers` though `POST` accepts it, and the console edit form for turso shows only Label. Steps nits: `schemaMode: "external"` on `POST` needs an `external` block; the console route is `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/metadata/datasource`.
- `connector-degraded-recovery`: acceptance[3].verify and step 7 say a reload reconcile "resets the backoff" — `degradeConnectorInstance` (service-automation `plugin.ts`) resets attempts only on a config-signature change; a reload retries immediately but keeps counting (measured: attempt 6, next delay 160 s). Split the wording (reload = immediate retry; config edit = reset). Step 7's "touch/save the entry" restarts `os dev`; a restart-free reload vehicle is `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/NAME?mode=draft` then `POST /api/v1/meta/view/NAME/publish`. Steps 1 and 6 need a scratch app copy (the stdio fixture path is cwd-relative). The info line `[Automation] recovered connector instance …` is absent at the default log level.
- `external-datasource-federated-read`: acceptance[2].oracle still reads `screenshot` though rev 2 made the API the oracle; the Setup route is `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/datasource` (`/_console/apps/setup/datasources` → "Object Not Found"); the external fixture DB lives in the shared tree (`examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/data/showcase_external.db`) — read-only, harmless.
- `job-scheduled-run`: steps[3]'s timeout probe has no retryPolicy, so it cannot show timeouts counting toward retries — add a second probe with a policy; scratch jobs need a writable app copy (copy the app, symlink node_modules, delete dist) — record it as the fixture recipe; `objectstack build` stops at the first bad job, so each bad shape needs its own build; `showcase_health_sweep` fires only at 01:00 UTC, so the cron variant rests on a scratch near-term cron.
- `notify-inbox-delivery`: `showcase_task.assignee` is a text field seeded with emails but the notify recipient resolves a USER ID — the reassignment must write the user id; receipts must be read as the recipient (the admin's `/data` view of `sys_notification_receipt` is owner-scoped); inbox deliveries do write `sys_notification_delivery` rows, so acceptance[4]'s "no delivery row" check must compare before/after counts.
